panel.title: Local models (Ollama)
panel.description: Run models on your own computer — your data never leaves the machine. An already-installed native Ollama is preferred; otherwise a managed Docker container is started.
panel.dockerUnavailable: Docker is unavailable. Start Docker Desktop, or install native Ollama — the app will pick it up at 127.0.0.1:11434 automatically.
panel.downloadEngineFirst: Download the engine first, then you can install models.
panel.startRuntimeFirst: Start the runtime to install models.

toast.pullStarted: Download of "{{name}}" started — you can close this window
toast.pullStartFailed: Failed to start the download of "{{name}}"
toast.startRuntimeFailed: Failed to start the runtime. Check Docker or the engine.

note.nvidiaSupported: GPU acceleration is available (NVIDIA), including inside the Docker container.
note.nvidiaUnsupported: NVIDIA detected, but passthrough to Docker is unavailable — the container will run on CPU.
note.apple: Docker on macOS does not pass through the GPU — the container will run on CPU. For Metal acceleration, install native Ollama.
note.amd: An AMD GPU is not passed through to Docker — the container will run on CPU. Native Ollama may use the GPU.
note.none: No GPU found — models run on CPU (slower).

installModal.description: The download runs locally. Progress is shown below.

catalog.searchPlaceholder: Search models or an exact name (e.g. mistral:7b)…
catalog.registryUnavailable: Registry search is unavailable — enter the exact model name.
catalog.nothingFound: Nothing found. Try a different name.
catalog.notEnoughMemory: Not enough memory — the model will not fit
